8.description: Chief McBride provided updates on various community engagements, police initiatives, and upcoming public programs.

chips.text: Public can dispose of electronics at SPS on March 5.
Acknowledged passing of Elder Melvina Eagle, Chief’s Advisory Committee member.
SPS hosts data destruction and electronic recycling program.

20.description: The Saskatoon Police Service and Combined Traffic Services Saskatchewan units reported on 2025 traffic enforcement, collision investigations, and road safety initiatives, noting staffing challenges and a drop in tickets.

chips.text: Chief McBride explained SPS receives no revenue from traffic tickets, fostering trust.
Why out-of-province red light camera tickets dropped significantly.
Staff committed to follow up on red light camera and school zone ticket data.

19.description: Saskatoon will renew its membership in the Canadian Association of Police Governance for 2026/2027, costing $5,652.00.
